name: Kisii
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and Swahili first-party discovery searches identified the official Kisii County land department, the State Department for Lands Kisii lands office directory, Ardhisasa and the Swahili service charter. Official pages establish local/national custodianship and procedures but expose no anonymous parcel ID+geometry service. The only bounded public feature query found was a non-government WWF Kenya ArcGIS layer whose extent excludes Kisii; its empty response is an extent miss. No GeoJSON sample was created.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [-0.670990402707098, 34.7615978139198] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted.
Local and national custodian evidence does not demonstrate public parcel geometry, complete city coverage, currentness or legal survey status.
No retained GeoJSON sample exists; no unchanged native geometry from Kisii was available anonymously.
Ardhisasa authentication/publication limits and the non-government layer's geographic extent are access and coverage limitations, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

nativeFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: No Kisii native parcel identity was observed in a safe anonymous response; no synthetic identity was created.

uncertainty: First-party evidence establishes Kisii County and State Department land/survey custodianship. Public parcel integration is not admitted because Ardhisasa did not provide an anonymous safe ID+geometry response and the only queried public feature layer does not cover Kisii. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception or unsafe field request was used.
